title: Laravel HTTPS Mixed Content — asset() vs secure_asset()
description: Mixed Content error terjadi karena asset() generate HTTP URLs di halaman HTTPS. secure_asset() auto-generate HTTPS URLs.
solution: Replace ALL asset() with secure_asset() in panel providers. Add URL::forceScheme('https') + URL::forceRootUrl(config('app.url')) unconditionally in AppServiceProvider.

title: Filament v5 Custom Login Page — Split Layout Architecture

title: Filament v5 Panel Architecture Reorg — Single Panel + Gate
description: Menghilangkan SuperAdmin panel terpisah. Semua role akses /app, dengan gate di resource-level untuk super_admin features.
solution: Hapus SuperAdminPanelProvider. Pindah semua resource ke /app. Gate super_admin role via canAccess(). $isScopedToTenant = false untuk global resources.

title: Back-to-Top Button — activeScroller Detection Pattern
description: Filament menggunakan custom scroll container .fi-main-ctn. window.scrollY tidak reliable. Capture phase event listener untuk detect any scrolling element.
solution: Use document.addEventListener('scroll', ..., true) capture phase. Track which element is scrolling as activeScroller. Poll fallback setInterval(updateVisibility, 800). Filament main container: .fi-main-ctn (NOT window).

title: JurnalService — Custom Double-Entry Accounting (Laravel 12)
solution: scottlaurent/accounting incompatible with Laravel 12. Solution: custom JurnalService with auto-journal observers on Penerimaan + Penyaluran (POSTED status). Account mapping: debit by metode_bayar (TUNAI=1-001, else 1-002); credit from kategoriPenerimaan->kode_akun. Journal number format: JRN-YYYYMM-XXXX. akun_perkiraan kode format: 1-001 (NOT 1-1-1).

solution: Komunita composeId: Gre0N0uR0Tg6oK2Mu_fxq | Angkain composeId: rT0VN4ALJFtf8KJ71ZFoQ. Deploy: push to GitHub -> git pull at /etc/dokploy/compose/<id>/code -> POST /api/compose.deploy. title: Stalwart SMTP Auth: Username = Short Name, Password via Web UI Only
description: Stalwart v0.15 auth menggunakan short username (misal: noreply, hadyan) bukan full email. Password HARUS dibuat via Web UI — API PATCH /api/principal secrets tidak bekerja untuk verifikasi SMTP meski hash format sha512crypt ($6$) secara lokal match.
solution: 1. Buat akun via Stalwart Web UI (https://mail.dekirulab.id). 2. Gunakan short username saat konfigurasi SMTP client (MAIL_USERNAME=noreply bukan noreply@dekirulab.id). 3. MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS boleh pakai full email.

title: Stalwart v0.15: Hapus [session.auth] dari config.toml — Konflik dengan RocksDB
description: Stalwart v0.15 menyimpan auth settings di RocksDB internal DB, bukan config.toml. Setting [session.auth] di config.toml akan menyebabkan error: Invalid variable or constant internal.
solution:
1. Hapus [session.auth] block dari config.toml
2. Set via Web UI atau API: auth.directory=internal, auth.mechanisms=plain login
3. Verify: GET /api/settings/list?prefix=auth
4. Restart container setelah perubahan toml

title: Docker Cross-Network: Container Reach Stalwart via Network Connect + Extra Hosts
description: Container di Docker network yang berbeda tidak bisa reach Stalwart via public domain. Perlu dua langkah: (1) join ke Stalwart network dan (2) tambah extra_hosts untuk resolve domain ke IP internal.
solution:
1. docker network connect compose-compress-bluetooth-firewall-6mv4q1_default <container_name>
2. Tambah di compose file:
   extra_hosts:
     - mail.dekirulab.id:10.0.4.2
3. docker compose up -d --force-recreate <service>

title: Stalwart v0.15: Hapus [session.auth] dari config.toml
description: Stalwart v0.15 menyimpan auth settings di RocksDB internal DB, bukan config.toml. Jika [session.auth] ada di toml, terjadi config parse error: 'Invalid variable or constant internal' dan auth gagal silently.
solution: Hapus seluruh [session.auth] block dari config.toml. Auth settings dikelola via DB — cek dengan GET /api/settings/list?prefix=auth. Harus ada: auth.directory=internal, auth.mechanisms=plain login, auth.require=true.

title: Docker Cross-Network: Stalwart + Dependent Containers
description: Container (Roundcube, Invoice Ninja) tidak bisa reach Stalwart via public domain/IP karena Docker network isolation. SSL cert juga tidak match jika pakai IP langsung.
solution: 2 langkah wajib: (1) docker network connect compose-compress-bluetooth-firewall-6mv4q1_default <container_name>. (2) Tambah extra_hosts: mail.dekirulab.id:10.0.4.2 di compose file agar SSL cert match. Perlu diulang setiap kali container di-recreate.

title: Stalwart SMTP: Username = Short Name, Password via Web UI Only
description: Stalwart v0.15 SMTP auth menggunakan short username (noreply, bukan noreply@dekirulab.id). Password WAJIB dibuat via Web UI — API PATCH /api/account/crypto tidak generate password yang valid untuk SMTP auth meski format hash benar ($6$ sha512crypt).
solution:
1. Buat akun via https://mail.dekirulab.id > Accounts

3. Jangan gunakan API untuk set password — Web UI only
4. Verifikasi: python3 -c import smtplib; s=smtplib.SMTP_SSL; s.login(short_name, pass)
